messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T13:15:00-07:00
Subject: SDK toolchain onramp — post-demo action items & local pilot checklist

Hi Sam — great to meet you and the BrightPath team today. Quick recap of the technical/next-step items we agreed and an initial local-environment checklist so your engineers can start a sandbox run this week. I copied Karthik and Marissa to own the tech workshop and sample app handoff.

Key outcomes from the call:
- Goal: Validate a local SDK + sample-app flow that demonstrates routing (tenant-aware), structured tool-calling, and an embeddings-backed reranker for search relevance.
- Success criteria for pilot: end-to-end response latency < 350ms P95 on local sim, demo of structured tool call (calendar api) and embedding-based rerank for the top-5 results.
- Constraints: BrightPath prefers API-key auth initially; SSO for later stages. Data residency: US only for this pilot.

Immediate items / owners:
1) Quickstart repo + README (attached + link) — priyom: share repo branch and quickstart commands.
2) Local env checklist — karthik: provide docker-compose snippet (GPU optional) + env var list.
3) Auth options doc — marissa: short note on API key vs OAuth and KMS best practices.
4) Workshop date — propose 60–90m technical workshop next week.

Local quickstart (Python + TS) — minimal steps to run locally:
- Python (sample app):
  - git clone <repo> && cd sample-apps/python-quickstart
  - python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
  - pip install -r requirements.txt
  - export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-live-... (we'll give a scoped key)
  - python run_sample.py --port 8080 --mode local

- TypeScript (sample app):
  - cd sample-apps/ts-demo
  - npm install
  - export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-live-...
  - npm run dev (then open localhost:3000)

Auth / routing notes:
- Default: API key per environment. For tenant routing, include header X-BP-Tenant: <tenant_id>.
- We recommend a middleware that maps tenant -> model alias + routing policy (latency vs cost).

Embeddings / reranker guidance:
- Use our embeddings endpoint to index chunked docs (max 1024 tokens/chunk).
- For reranking: fetch top-50 candidates by cosine, then rerank with model-compatible pairwise scorer. Our sample app includes a simple (embedding + cross-encoder) pipeline.

Attachments: redwood-sdk-quickstart.pdf (walkthrough), bp-map-2027-015.xlsx (mutual action plan template), sample-apps-readme.md

Next steps:
- Sam: confirm workshop attendees + preferred slot (Mon/Tue morning PT preferred).
- Karthik: will drop a docker-compose snippet and test matrix by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward to the workshop.

Best,
Priyom
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai | (555) 867-2001

Priyom — thanks for the summary. Quick technical notes and what I'll deliver by EOD tomorrow: 

1) Docker-compose snippet (dev):
- service: redis (for embedding cache), postgres (metadata), sample-app (python), redis-insight (optional).
- We will include an env.example with REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_BASE_URL, BP_TENANT_ID.

2) Local performance knobs:
- For local GPU-less runs we default to the tiny quantized model (redwood-mini-q8). Latency sim will be approximate; the workshop will mark expected delta vs dedicated.

3) Ephemeral key example:
- I'll add a small auth-proxy script (node) that mints a short-lived token using a scoped API key and returns it to the client (30m TTL). This will address the ephemeral key ask for the PoC.

4) Embedding strategy for 120k docs:
- Chunk at 400–600 tokens, shard indexing into 8 parallel workers (sample script included). We will provide estimated indexing time and an S3-compatible snapshot sample so you can run a smaller smoke test locally.

5) Calendar demo scopes:
- We'll use a delegated Google Calendar service account with read/write access to a test calendar. We'll include the calendar token setup instructions in the workshop packet.

Deliverables by 2027-06-02 EOD:
- docker-compose.dev.yml + env.example
- small node auth-proxy (ephemeral key example) + README
- indexing script + sample dataset (S3 link)

I can lead the hands-on portion on either 06/07 or 06/08. Prefer 06/07 morning PT.

-Karthik
